P01.rationale: No portrait or human figure of any size is present on the page.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits anywhere on the page.

P07.rationale: Three pill-shaped client name badges ('Frese Recruiting', 'Conesso GmbH', 'Pure Media Marketing') form a minimal logo/name wall, but there are no logos, ratings, or testimonial quotes to constitute a proper social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative numerals, large quote glyphs, or any giant typographic elements are present.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, charts, before/after comparisons, or number-bound graphics appear anywhere on the page.

P12.rationale: The page is almost entirely blank below the three name badges, making it extremely sparse and far from a dense editorial layout.

P13.rationale: There is a very subtle warm off-white/cream background tone, but it reads as near-flat with no intentional texture or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable and scores absent.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup of any kind is present on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains only text labels in pill badges with no imagery at all, so there is nothing specifically generic or stock, but the absence of any real visuals is itself a credibility weakness.

N08.rationale: The vast majority of the page — roughly 85% of the sheet below the header row — is completely empty white space with no content whatsoever.

N10.rationale: There are no photos on the page, so there is no issue of text sitting on a busy image without a scrim.
